name: atago
summary: Tests real CLI behavior from YAML specs checking exit codes, output, files and terminals.
use_cases: Check exit code, stdout and stderr of a command
Check generated files and compare snapshots
Drive interactive prompts and TUIs via PTY
Record a real run into a test spec
Test CLI against a background server
features: Check exit code, stdout, and stderr

smoke_tests.observed_excerpt: PASSED 1 scenario: 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 errored, 0 skipped (2ms)

setup.command:
mkdir -p specs && cat > specs/f1.atago.yaml <<'YAML'
version: "1"
suite:
  name: example
scenarios:
  - name: echo greets the world
    steps:
      - run:
          shell: true
          command: echo "hello atago"
      - assert:
          exit_code: 0
          stdout:
            contains: atago
          stderr:
            empty: true
YAML
cat > specs/f2.atago.yaml <<'YAML'
version: "1"
suite:
  name: files-example
scenarios:
  - name: the generator writes the expected files
    steps:
      - run:
          shell: true
          command: mkdir -p site && echo "<html>hello</html>" > site/index.html && cat site/index.html
      - assert:
          file:
            path: site/index.html
            contains:
              - "<html"
YAML
cat > specs/f3.atago.yaml <<'YAML'
version: "1"
suite:
  name: pty-example
scenarios:
  - name: the init wizard completes
    steps:
      - pty:
          command: sh -c 'printf "Project name: "; read name; echo "created $name/"'
          session:
            - expect: "Project name:"
            - send: "demo\n"
            - expect: "created demo/"
      - assert:
          exit_code: 0
YAML
ls -la specs/ && cat specs/f1.atago.yaml

pitfalls.readme_said: go install github.com/nao1215/atago@latest (requires Go 1.26.10+); yay -S atago-bin; aqua g -i nao1215/atago; mise use -g aqua:nao1215/atago

pitfalls.readme_said: README wizard example uses a bare command without ': ' so needs no quoting
pitfalls.actually_needed: quote a pty/run command value containing ': ' in double quotes or it fails to load with ATG2003
